affiliate.disclosure_test: Ad · test identifier (no real affiliate programme)
affiliate.disclosure_long: This is an affiliate link. If you book through it, we receive a commission from the provider. The price you pay does not change as a result. Our recommendation is based solely on price – not on the commission.
affiliate.legal_notice: We act as an intermediary for travel services; we are not a tour operator. The contract for each service is concluded exclusively with the respective provider, where payment is also made. We do not accept any payments and do not pass booking or payment data on to other providers. The totals shown in comparisons are comparative values and not a total-price offer. Translation for information purposes only; the German version is legally binding.
affiliate.bundle_notice: The bundle is a price comparison, not a package offer. Each service is selected and paid for separately with the respective provider (§ 651b of the German Civil Code (BGB): no single booking process, no total price).
affiliate.no_payment: This interface does not take any payment and does not store any payment data.
affiliate.reason.no_program: no affiliate programme for this provider (no commission possible)
affiliate.reason.test_disabled: test partner disabled in normal operation
affiliate.reason.no_id: Partner {network} is known, but no ID is configured – no affiliate link (no invented identifier)
affiliate.reason.no_template: Partner {network} has no link template (copy one from the dashboard) – no affiliate link
affiliate.reason.already_tagged: link is already tagged – not tagging it twice
